name: gitignore-template-drift
cost_provenance: measured 2026-06-12 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; under-declaration causes timeout kills
question: Does this project's .gitignore lack any framework-managed patterns from the current claude-template baseline?

assertion.asserts: this project's .gitignore covers every ephemeral framework artifact class that must never be committed
assertion.measures: line-trimmed exact string equality between the non-comment, non-blank lines following the '# Claude Code (session artifacts - never commit)' header of the RESOLVED baseline (~/.claude/.gitignore when deployed, else claude-template/.gitignore) and the lines of ./.gitignore. No path is tested against git; git check-ignore is never run.
known_gaps: THE CENTRAL GAP (DISC-PRO-38 / DEC-378): a class that SHOULD be ignored but is absent from the baseline is invisible by construction, because drift is measured against the baseline -- a detector of divergence FROM a list cannot see that the list is short. Witnessed: live .claude/collaboration/collab-*/ dirs were committable in every ULDF project while this oracle reported drifted=false in all of them; 173 such files were committed by a950aaec and untracked by 98e920f2, and 32 remain tracked in three projects as of 2026-08-17. Nothing is done about it and nothing can be: baseline completeness is a judgment question, excluded from mechanization by Oraculurgy's Four-Part Qualification Test (OVALID-04). The bound is stated, not closed.

Exact-line matching measures SPELLINGS, not effective ignore status. A project that ignores the same paths under a different but equivalent pattern is reported drifted (false positive); a project whose baseline line is present while an earlier negation re-includes the path is reported covered (false negative). git check-ignore is the effective test and is not run.

Baseline resolution prefers the DEPLOYED ~/.claude/.gitignore over claude-template/.gitignore, so a pattern added to the template baseline is invisible to every project -- including the framework repo itself -- until sync. Measured 2026-08-17: immediately after HYGIENE-06 landed in the template, this oracle still reported drifted=false with baseline_patterns=19 here, while the same run against the template reported 20.

Only lines under the framework header are managed. A baseline pattern added elsewhere in the file is silently uncounted, so the header is load-bearing and a correct pattern in the wrong section reads as no pattern at all.

Says nothing about TRACKED state. gitignore is not retroactive, so a path already committed stays committed after its pattern lands; /0-uldf-migrate-hygiene owns that half and this oracle cannot see it.

schema.missing_patterns: array of string (verbatim baseline pattern lines absent from project .gitignore)
schema.project_patterns: integer (total non-comment, non-blank lines in project .gitignore)
schema.briefing: string (empty when drifted=false OR baseline missing; otherwise: 'gitignore-template-drift: N framework patterns missing — run /0-uldf-migrate-hygiene to update')

fallback: Read claude-template/.gitignore (or ~/.claude/.gitignore when deployed). Extract non-comment, non-blank lines under the '# Claude Code (session artifacts — never commit)' header (these are the framework-managed patterns). Read project .gitignore and compare line-trimmed exact matches; missing baseline lines are drift. When no drift: briefing line is empty/absent. When drift: 'gitignore-template-drift: N framework patterns missing — run /0-uldf-migrate-hygiene to update'.

baseline_resolution.graceful_absent: When no baseline found: drifted=false, briefing='', exit 0

project_resolution.graceful_absent: When project .gitignore missing: project_patterns=0, missing_patterns=all baseline, drifted=true

briefing_line_convention: Empty briefing string = suppress line (per ULDF gracefully-absent convention). Hook MUST NOT print 'No drift detected' fallback.

provenance.note: Companion to /0-uldf-migrate-hygiene (HYGIENE-02). Surfaces baseline drift in the session-start ORACLE BRIEFING so legacy projects (those that ran /0-uldf-setup-project before CSI Phase 1+1.5+1.6+HYGIENE-01) get nudged onto the post-CSI-1.6 baseline. Companion oracle pattern lineage: dispatchable-sessions (briefing line that surfaces actionable state).
